title: Six States Sign Agreement for Kishau Multipurpose Project
summary: Six states and a Union Territory have signed an agreement for the Kishau multipurpose water and power project on the Tons river. Situated along the Uttarakhand-Himachal Pradesh border, the project aims to enhance regional water and power management.
point1: Six states and one UT signed an inter-state pact for the Kishau multipurpose project.
point2: The project will harness the Tons river for water sharing and power generation across partner states.

title: India's August CPI Inflation Hits 20-Month High of 4.8%
summary: India’s retail inflation rose to a 20-month high of 4.8% in August, driven largely by higher food costs. Economists expect the jump in Consumer Price Index inflation to increase the likelihood of a Reserve Bank of India interest rate hike in October.
point1: Retail inflation in August increased to 4.8%, reaching its highest level in 20 months.
point2: Elevated food prices drove up the CPI, creating potential pressure for RBI monetary tightening.
point3: RBI's next policy decision is expected in October 2026.

title: NPCI and RBI Introduce 0.4% Fee on UPI Merchant Transactions Over ₹2,000
summary: The National Payments Corporation of India and RBI have introduced a 0.4% Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) on UPI merchant payments above ₹2,000. Person-to-person transfers, small vendors, and payments under ₹2,000 remain fully exempt, with the fee applying to about 4% of merchant transactions.
point1: A 0.4% MDR charge will apply to UPI merchant transactions above ₹2,000.
point2: Small merchants and P2P transfers remain exempt to preserve broad digital payment adoption while supporting network infrastructure costs.

title: SpaceX Sets September 22 Target for First Starship Orbital Attempt
summary: SpaceX is scheduled to attempt placing its Starship rocket into Earth orbit for the first time on September 22. The mission will also attempt to launch the first V3 Starlink satellites into orbit.
point1: SpaceX targets September 22 for Starship's first orbital attempt.
point2: The launch will test orbital capabilities and deploy next-generation V3 Starlink satellites.

title: U.S. Military Acknowledges Orbiting Space Weapons in First Public Confirmation
summary: The U.S. military has publicly acknowledged putting a space weapon into Earth's orbit for the first time. The statement marks an unprecedented public disclosure regarding military capabilities deployed in space.
point1: The U.S. military confirmed it deployed a space weapon into Earth's orbit.
point2: This is the first public acknowledgment of an operational orbital space weapon by the U.S. military.

title: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind Hold Joint AI Safety Talks
summary: OpenAI has confirmed weeks of joint AI safety talks with Anthropic and Google DeepMind. The collaborative safety discussions follow calls from industry leaders for safeguards, even as White House officials prioritize rapid development to keep pace with China.
point1: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google DeepMind have conducted weeks of joint discussions on AI safety.
point2: The coordination among leading frontier AI labs comes amid political debate over government regulation and global competition.

title: Indian passenger vehicle sales rise 36.5% year-on-year in August 2026
summary: Domestic passenger vehicle sales in India jumped 36.5% year-on-year in August 2026, according to data from the Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers (SIAM). The sharp growth was supported by strong consumer demand and a lower statistical base from the prior year.
point1: Passenger vehicle sales in India recorded a 36.5% year-on-year expansion in August 2026.
point2: Reflects solid consumer demand and automotive industry growth ahead of the festive season.

title: Indian rupee falls to 95.84 against US dollar as crude oil surges
summary: The Indian rupee declined by 30 paise to 95.84 against the US dollar in early trading. The fall was driven by global Brent crude prices surpassing $106 per barrel, which raised dollar demand among domestic energy importers.
point1: The rupee dropped 30 paise due to surging global crude oil prices and increased dollar demand.
point2: Rising crude import costs add strain to India's trade balance and elevate domestic inflation risks.

title: NATO jets shoot down drone entering Lithuanian airspace
summary: NATO fighter jets intercepted and shot down an unidentified drone that entered Lithuanian airspace. Authorities stated the drone likely entered NATO territory from neighboring Belarus.
point1: NATO aircraft destroyed an unauthorized drone violating Lithuanian airspace.
point2: Highlights ongoing airspace incursions and security concerns along NATO's eastern frontier.

title: Denmark accuses Russian warship of firing flares at military helicopter
summary: Danish authorities reported that a Russian naval vessel fired flares toward a Danish military helicopter operating in international airspace. Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen accused Russia of reckless behavior during the incident.
point1: A Russian warship targeted a Danish military helicopter with signal flares.
point2: Escalates maritime and military tensions between Baltic NATO allies and Russia.

title: Supreme Court blocks Trump's plan to restrict mail-in ballots
summary: The US Supreme Court has rejected an emergency request from the Trump administration to lift a temporary injunction blocking new Postal Service mail-in ballot restrictions. The ruling prevents the administration from implementing the contested rules ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.
point1: The Supreme Court declined to overturn a federal court injunction on Postal Service voting restrictions.
point2: Ensures mail-in voting rules remain unchanged for the upcoming US midterm elections.

title: US confirms for first time it has deployed space weapons
summary: The United States Secretary of the Air Force has confirmed for the first time that the US military has deployed operational space weapons. Officials stated that the weaponry is necessary to defend the country and its space assets against potential enemy action.
point1: US Air Force Secretary publicly confirmed the deployment of space weapons by the US military.
point2: Marks the first official public confirmation that operational US space weapons have been fielded.

title: Chief Justice of India Declares Judiciary Must Remain Open to Public Scrutiny
summary: Chief Justice of India stated that the judicial institution cannot build public confidence by shielding its decisions from outside review. Addressing judicial accountability, the CJI stressed that courts must accept public examination, questioning, and legitimate criticism.
point1: CJI emphasized that judicial trust requires openness to public examination and criticism.
point2: Highlights senior judicial leadership's stance on institutional transparency and accountability.

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang tells Trump ‘we’re not going to let [an AI slowdown] happen’
summary: Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang informed Donald Trump that Nvidia will not allow a slowdown in artificial intelligence development. Huang's stance contrasts with recent calls from Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, as well as comments from Elon Musk and Sam Altman supporting safety safeguards.
point1: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told Donald Trump that the company will not allow an AI development slowdown.
point2: The statement opposes calls from other industry leaders for safety-driven slowdowns or regulatory limits.

title: Indian Government Prohibits Bank Fees on Digital Payments Up to ₹2,000
summary: The Indian government has issued a notification under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007, prohibiting banks from imposing transaction charges on UPI and RuPay debit card payments up to ₹2,000.
point1: The government barred bank charges on UPI and RuPay debit transactions up to ₹2,000.
point2: The policy mandate was issued via statutory changes to the Payment and Settlement Systems Act.
point3: The directive takes effect following official notification.

title: Apple Releases iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 Featuring Overhauled Siri
summary: Apple released iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 for public download on September 14. The major mobile operating system updates focus heavily on upgrades and enhancements to the Siri assistant.
point1: Apple launched iOS 27 and iPadOS 27 on September 14.
point2: The update brings an extensive overhaul to Siri and user interface elements across iPhone and iPad.
point3: The updates are available immediately for supported Apple devices.

title: Microsoft Issues New AI Safety Code of Conduct for Models
summary: Microsoft has introduced a new AI code of conduct laying out foundational principles and safety constraints for its models. The guidelines instruct models not to hack software systems or deceive human users.
point1: Microsoft established a formal code of conduct for its artificial intelligence models.
point2: The rules explicitly mandate that AI models avoid system hacking and human deception.

title: OpenAI Buys Smartphone Camera Maker Glass Imaging for $300 Million
summary: OpenAI has acquired smartphone camera startup Glass Imaging in a deal valued at $300 million, according to reporting. The startup was founded by former Apple engineers who previously led the team behind Apple's Portrait Mode.
point1: OpenAI acquired Glass Imaging in a deal reported to be worth $300 million.
point2: The startup was created by former Apple engineers responsible for developing iPhone Portrait Mode.

title: India Fast-Tracks Emergency Power Exports to Flood-Hit Nepal
summary: India's Power Ministry has approved expedited electricity exports to Nepal to assist the country amid severe flood-induced power grid disruptions. The emergency supply is designed to support Nepal's domestic energy demand and vital infrastructure operations during relief efforts.
point1: India authorized emergency electricity exports to Nepal during acute flooding.
point2: Provides critical grid stability and relief support to neighboring Nepal during severe natural disasters.

title: China Foreign Minister Urges Progress in Bilateral Ties with India
summary: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi stated that China-India relations are progressing toward a renewed height following high-level leader engagements and urged both sides to move forward without backsliding. The diplomatic remarks follow efforts by New Delhi and Beijing to stabilize border issues and economic ties.
point1: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi called for steadily advancing bilateral relations with India.
point2: Signals formal diplomatic effort to move beyond the recent low point in bilateral border and geopolitical tension.

title: India's Retail Inflation Rises to 4.82% in August Driven by Food Prices
summary: India's Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation rose to 4.82% in August, driven up by an increase in food inflation to 5.95% from 5.52% in July. Data released by the National Statistics Office highlights continuing inflationary pressure in daily essential goods.
point1: Retail inflation in India increased to 4.82% in August, while food inflation reached 5.95%.
point2: Accelerating food costs complicate macroeconomic policy and purchasing power across Indian households.

title: China Rejects Allegations of 'Malicious Competition' in Global AI Race
summary: China has rejected claims that it engages in malicious competition in artificial intelligence development following calls by Western AI executives to slow progress. Beijing urged global cooperation on technical standards while warning against using safety as a pretext to restrict competitors.
point1: China's foreign ministry pushed back against Western statements suggesting Chinese AI growth poses unfair competition.
point2: Highlights growing international geopolitical friction surrounding global AI safety regulation and strategic dominance.

title: Automattic Board Replaced After Failed Attempt to Oust CEO Matt Mullenweg
summary: The board of directors at Automattic has been replaced following a failed vote to place Chief Executive Officer Matt Mullenweg on leave. The executive shake-up follows escalating internal disputes over management and strategic direction at the WordPress parent firm.
point1: Automattic's board was ousted after attempting to force CEO Matt Mullenweg onto leave.
point2: Represents a dramatic shift in governance for the company that controls critical web publishing infrastructure.

title: Waymo Expands Commercial Robotaxi Operations to Las Vegas
summary: Autonomous vehicle developer Waymo has officially opened its commercial driverless ride-hailing service in Las Vegas. The Nevada deployment marks the company's 15th commercial robotaxi market.
point1: Waymo launched commercial autonomous ride-hailing services in Las Vegas, Nevada.
point2: Las Vegas becomes Waymo's 15th operational commercial robotaxi market in the United States.

title: Manhattan Prosecutor Seizes 12 Deepfake Websites Targeting 1,200 Victims
summary: The Manhattan District Attorney’s Office has seized 12 websites creating non-consensual sexually explicit deepfake media in the largest law enforcement action of its kind. The targeted platforms collectively impacted approximately 1,200 identified victims, including celebrities and public figures.
point1: Manhattan law enforcement seized 12 illicit deepfake domains targeting around 1,200 victims.
point2: Marks the largest enforcement action taken by legal authorities against harmful explicit deepfake platforms.

title: AI industry leaders call for slowdown as Trump administration responds
summary: AI leaders including Sam Altman, Elon Musk, and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei have backed calls for restraint in frontier AI development. Donald Trump's administration responded by emphasizing that restraint rests with private companies while focusing on maintaining US leadership over China.
point1: Industry executives Sam Altman, Elon Musk, and Dario Amodei signaled support for pacing AI development.
point2: The Trump administration placed responsibility for restraint on companies while prioritizing geopolitical competition with China.

title: India secures increased steel export quota in European Union agreement
summary: India has secured an additional preferential export quota of 694,853 tons of steel into the European Union market. The new allocation comes on top of an existing WTO quota of 946,616 tons, expanding trade access for Indian steelmakers.
point1: The EU granted India an additional preferential steel quota of 694,853 tons.
point2: The deal expands Indian market access alongside an existing 946,616 ton WTO quota.

title: India's wholesale inflation surges to 9.92% in August driven by food and fuel
summary: India's Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation accelerated to 9.92% in August due to elevated prices across food, fuel, and manufactured items. Inflation in manufactured products reached a series high of 8.37%, up from 8.29% in July. The sharp increase accentuates cost pressures across the Indian economy.
point1: Wholesale inflation in India reached 9.92% in August.
point2: Manufactured goods inflation reached a series high of 8.37%.

title: Crude Oil Prices Surge Past $108 Following Strikes on Saudi Infrastructure and Strait of Hormuz
summary: Global oil benchmarks surged over 3% following military strikes targeting Saudi energy infrastructure and shipping routes near the Strait of Hormuz. Brent crude futures rose to $108.23 per barrel, raising inflation and import bill concerns for India.
point1: Brent crude prices surged by $3.62 to $108.23 per barrel after fresh strikes near key Middle East energy corridors.
point2: Escalating regional conflict threatens global supply lines and poses significant economic risks for major oil importers like India.
point3: Energy markets remain volatile as regional security conditions develop.

title: West Bengal Issues Closure Orders for 252 Unrecognized Madrasas
summary: The West Bengal government issued formal closure notices to 252 unrecognised and unaided madrasas across the state. The move impacts institutions operating outside the state's recognized educational regulatory structure.
point1: Closure notices were served to 252 unaided madrasas operating without government recognition in West Bengal.
point2: The enforcement targets unaccredited educational institutions operating within the state.
point3: Implementation of closure orders is expected per state government directives.

title: US Executes First Alien Terrorist Removal Court Deportation
summary: United States authorities deported a female legal U.S. resident of Afghan nationality using the Alien Terrorist Removal Court mechanism for the first time. The individual was never charged with a crime but was ordered removed due to alleged family links to terrorism.
point1: The US completed its first deportation proceeding under the specialized Alien Terrorist Removal Court process.
point2: The legal precedent expands executive enforcement mechanisms for deporting legal residents suspected of terror ties without criminal trial.

title: Meta Sued in Class Action Over AI and Facial Recognition Training Data
summary: A proposed class-action lawsuit filed against Meta alleges the company improperly harvested user photos from Facebook and Instagram to train its AI models. The lawsuit claims the data was used to build AI image-generation models and develop an unreleased facial recognition feature called NameTag.
point1: The proposed class action accuses Meta of illegally utilizing user photos from Facebook and Instagram without consent.
point2: The suit targets both Meta's AI image-generation systems and its internal facial-recognition projects.

title: Projections Show Tight Swedish Election Race With Opposition Left Bloc Leading by One Seat
summary: Sweden's election authority projected a narrow one-seat majority for the left-wing opposition bloc following Sunday's national vote. Tallying shows the country's main political coalitions in a virtually tied contest.
point1: Election projections show Sweden's opposition left bloc holding a single-seat lead.
point2: Determines parliamentary power and the future composition of Sweden's government.
point3: Official vote counting by election authorities continues.

title: Larry Ellison Cancels Planned $7.5 Billion Oracle Stock Sale
summary: Oracle co-founder Larry Ellison has canceled his planned sale of 50 million shares of Oracle stock. The transaction was previously disclosed and valued at approximately $7.5 billion.
point1: Larry Ellison canceled a previously disclosed plan to sell 50 million shares of Oracle stock.
point2: Reverses a massive planned insider stock transaction by Oracle's co-founder.

title: Trump Announces Plan to Eliminate US Tariffs on Irish Whiskey
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump announced plans to remove all import tariffs on Irish whiskey following a two-day visit to Ireland. Irish whiskey is currently subject to a 15% standard tariff levied on EU goods entering the United States.
point1: President Trump pledged to remove the 15% import tariff on Irish whiskey.
point2: Alters trade duties affecting European Union agricultural and beverage exports to the U.S.

title: Indian Women's Cricket Team Refuses Asia Cup Presentation Over ACC Head
summary: India's women's cricket team defeated Sri Lanka by 72 runs to secure their eighth Asia Cup title but declined to participate in post-match field presentations. The players refused to receive the championship trophy from Asian Cricket Council head Mohsin Naqvi.
point1: India secured its eighth Asia Cup women's cricket title after beating Sri Lanka.
point2: Players declined to participate in post-match presentation ceremonies led by ACC head Mohsin Naqvi.

title: Bangladesh State Minister Calls for Reset of Bilateral Relations With India
summary: Bangladesh State Minister for Foreign Affairs Humaiun Kobir stated that Dhaka wants to reset its bilateral relationship with India through direct discussions. Kobir noted that Bangladesh needs to adopt a balanced diplomatic stance and move past an excessive preoccupation with New Delhi.
point1: Bangladesh foreign ministry official called for direct bilateral talks to reset relations with India.
point2: Signals ongoing recalibration in South Asian foreign policy and diplomatic priorities.
